title: Chain of axial springs: flexibility matrix of the changed structure

source.work: McGuire, W., Gallagher, R. H., Ziemian, R. D., Matrix Structural Analysis
source.notes: input data and targets read on the cited pages; nothing of the source is reproduced

analysis: Pin-jointed plane truss in the x-y plane (global Y vertical): members of type 'truss'; the out-of-plane translation of every joint is held by a support (it has no stiffness in a plane truss). Chain of four axial springs along x between fixed ends 1 and 5, free nodes 2, 3, 4. The source's stiffnesses are dimensionless; here kN/mm: k = 2, 2, 3, 2 (member 1-2 changed from 1 to 2). Each spring is a truss member of 1000 mm with E = 200 kN/mm^2 and A = 5 k mm^2 (EA/L = k). The transverse translations of the collinear joints are held. Three combinations with a unit load (1 kN) at node 2, 3, 4: the displacements are the flexibility coefficients the source prints as exact fractions. First order.
